report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 in ~50-60ms; traces show the failure originates at payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, while inventory/reservations succeed. Order metrics show zero /v1/orders traffic and no save_order activity, and payment logs/metrics were excluded from context, so the payment-side fault cannot be bounded to a taxonomy cause. Handing off for payment-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics for /v1/authorizations around the incident window (excluded from context)
Payment dependency operations (DB/Redis) outcomes to distinguish http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or bad-configuration
Payment deployment/version facts to rule out a bad-configuration or version regression
Order service logs to confirm whether order received and forwarded requests during the window
